# Alveryn

Alveryn is a web application for people whose working hours, activities, payment methods, and absences vary.

Official website: https://alveryn.com/

## What Alveryn does

- Tracks working time with check-in/check-out or manual entries.
- Records hourly work, output paid per unit, and fixed-price jobs.
- Keeps multiple employments, work types, rates, and payment rules separate.
- Organizes workdays, earnings, leave, sickness, and other absences.
- Shows daily, weekly, and monthly work history and statistics.
- Supports an optional hours balance account that compares worked hours with a target.

## Intended users

Alveryn is intended for hourly workers, people with multiple jobs, shift workers, and people whose pay depends on completed units or jobs.

## Access

Alveryn currently offers free account creation at https://alveryn.com/register.
Existing users can sign in at https://alveryn.com/login.
